name: LeadForge Pro — B2B Prospecting & Outreach Pipeline

parameters.formDescription: Finds companies by category and location, enriches decision-maker contacts, verifies emails, and adds verified leads to your Instantly.ai campaign automatically.

values.placeholder: e.g. fencing contractor, steel mesh supplier, construction supplier
e.g. Melbourne VIC, Sydney NSW, Queensland

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "organization_ids": ["{{ $json.organizations[0].id }}"],
  "person_titles": [
    "Purchasing Manager","Head of Purchasing","Director of Purchasing",
    "Procurement Manager","Senior Buyer","Buyer","Sourcing Manager","Supply Chain Manager",
    "Operations Manager","Operations Director","Fulfillment Manager",
    "Warehouse Manager","Production Manager",
    "General Manager","Managing Director",
    "Founder","Owner","CEO","President"
  ],
  "include_similar_titles": true,
  "contact_email_status": ["verified","likely to engage","guessed"],
  "per_page": 10
}

={
  "api_key": "REPLACE_INSTANTLY_API_KEY",
  "campaign_id": "REPLACE_INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_ID",
  "skip_if_in_workspace": true,
  "leads": [{
    "email": "{{ $json.contact_email }}",
    "first_name": "{{ $json.contact_first_name }}",
    "last_name": "{{ $json.contact_last_name }}",
    "company_name": "{{ $json.company_name }}",
    "website": "{{ $json.company_domain }}",
    "personalization": "Hi {{ $json.contact_first_name }}, noticed {{ $json.company_name }} is in the fencing space",
    "custom_variables": {
      "title": "{{ $json.contact_title }}",
      "persona_tier": "{{ $json.persona_tier }}",
      "persona_label": "{{ $json.persona_label }}",
      "linkedin": "{{ $json.contact_linkedin }}",
      "org_headcount": "{{ $json.org_headcount }}",
      "org_location": "{{ $json.org_location }}"
    }
  }]
}

assignments.name: error_reason
assignments.value: Email found but ZeroBounce confidence <95% — verify manually before sending

parameters.url: =https://api.hunter.io/v2/email-finder?domain={{ $('Pick Best 1-2 Contacts').item.json.company_domain }}&first_name={{ $('Pick Best 1-2 Contacts').item.json.contact_first_name }}&last_name={{ $('Pick Best 1-2 Contacts').item.json.contact_last_name }}&api_key=REPLACE_HUNTER_API_KEY

assignments.name: error_reason
assignments.value: Hunter email found but ZeroBounce confidence <95% — verify manually

assignments.name: error_reason
assignments.value: Company domain not found in Apollo — try parent domain or check spelling

assignments.value: LinkedIn email found but ZeroBounce confidence <95% — verify manually
